final class UdpVideoProbe {
/* ACTUAL_PREPARATION */
/* ACTUAL_WRAPPER */
    final CountDownLatch entered=new CountDownLatch(1),permit=new CountDownLatch(1);
    String mode;int calls;
    private void runOwnerStart(){
        calls++;OwnerMediaObservation value=ownerResources.get();
        if(value==null){entered.countDown();return;}
        value.published(this,new Object(),4,new Object(),7,null,null,null,null);
        value.closing(this);value.closeReturns(this,true,1,true);value.nativeDestroyed(this,7);
        value.listener(this,false);entered.countDown();
        if(mode.equals("pending"))try{if(!permit.await(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError();}
            catch(InterruptedException error){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();throw new AssertionError(error);}
        if(mode.equals("throw"))throw new IllegalStateException("fixture-only listener failure");
        value.listener(this,true);
    }
}
